title: Crème Brûlée
description: A traditional France dish made with heavy cream, egg yolk. This home-style preparation follows its characteristic cooking method and uses measured ingredients.

steps.instruction: Warm the vanilla bean in the cream to steaming, keeping it below a full boil to preserve its delicate aroma.
Whisk yolks with sugar and slowly temper with warm vanilla cream. Strain into ramekins in a hot-water bath; bake at 150°C for approximately 30–40 minutes until just set.
Refrigerate the cooled baked custards for about 3 hours until properly cold and firm.
Immediately before serving, spread a very thin layer of sugar over the cold custards and caramelize with a kitchen blowtorch until crisp and golden.
